raw_response: {"diagnosis": "Customers moved to the new CRM (change note dated 2026-01-15) now send a numeric region code ('01' to '04') in place of a region name. silver_customers passes these codes through unchanged, so 60 customers land in invalid regions in silver_customers and gold_region_daily. raw_region_map holds a complete one-to-one mapping (01=WEST, 02=EAST, 03=NORTH, 04=SOUTH) for all four codes.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.88, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_customers": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_customers AS SELECT c.customer_id, upper(COALESCE(m.region_name, c.region)) AS region FROM raw_customers c LEFT JOIN raw_region_map m ON c.region = m.region_code"}}
